name: StepHaven
summary: StepHaven is a cozy town builder for iPhone that you play by walking. Steps from Apple Health become points you spend on cottages, gardens, ponds, canals, trains and more than 500 other things to build. Villagers move in, wild animals visit, and the town follows the real time of day and the seasons. Players can design their own houses and build one town together with friends. Building points can't be bought and there are no ads. Wheelchair pushes recorded by Apple Watch count the same as steps.
